items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So I went to Germany with Dusko Goykovich's band

ctx.x: No. Well, it happened the 6th of December, 1975, so I didn't work all December, January, and I started back a little bit in the month of February. That's when I went to Germany. I said, "Oh, I have to play. I can't be sitting around like this. I'll forget how to play." So I went to Germany with Dusko Goykovich's band, and I stayed up there awhile, and got myself -- I felt good and got back to playing again.
